## 1. Executive Summary & Core Identity

VISTAR is a founder-led engineering studio based in Lucknow, India, led by Abhishek Tiwari. We engineer high-performance web applications, bespoke business platforms, WhatsApp conversational workflows, and interactive 3D WebGL experiences.

Unlike traditional marketing agencies that assemble fragile templates or deliver slide decks, VISTAR operates as a focused technical partner. Every project is engineered directly with modern tools (Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS), deployed on edge-native cloud infrastructure (Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare), and handed over with complete GitHub repository rights on day one.

## 2. Core Technical Capabilities

### 2.1. Modern Full-Stack & Next.js Web Engineering
* **Architectural Approach:** High-performance, edge-optimized web applications compiled with Next.js 15/16 (App Router), React 19, and strict TypeScript.
* **Capabilities:**
  * Sub-100ms response targets with Core Web Vitals optimization.

### 2.2. WhatsApp Business & Operational Automation
* **Architectural Approach:** Direct integration with Meta's official WhatsApp Business Cloud API for high-conversion communication and customer workflows.
* **Capabilities:**

  * Reduced friction for Indian and international businesses where WhatsApp is the primary communication channel.
* **Reference Route:** https://www.vistar.tech/vectors

### 2.3. Spatial WebGL & Interactive 3D Systems

## 3. Verified Portfolio & Open Source Work

### 3.1. 3axis Arc — Spatial 3D Architecture Platform
* **Domain:** Spatial Computing & Architecture
* **Stack:** Next.js 15/React 19, Three.js, Tailwind CSS
* **Overview:** Interactive 3D perspective viewer allowing prospective buyers to inspect spatial architecture models at 60fps in their browser.
* **Live System URL:** https://3axisarc.vercel.app

### 3.2. Project VAYU — Aviation Cockpit Telemetry & NOTAM AI (Open Source)
* **Domain:** Aviation & GIS Hazard Exploration
* **Stack:** Next.js, Open Source GIS primitives, NLP parser
* **Overview:** Open-source situational awareness tool that parses aviation NOTAM advisories into visual GIS map overlays.
* **Live System URL:** https://ai-vayu.vercel.app

### 3.3. AURA — Healthcare Biometric Anomaly Detection (Prototype)
* **Domain:** Healthcare IoT Telemetry
* **Stack:** Python, Flask/FastAPI, scikit-learn (Isolation Forest)
* **Overview:** Research prototype evaluating unsupervised Isolation Forest algorithms against synthetic multi-vital telemetry streams.
* **Live System URL:** https://multi-agent-anomaly-system.onrender.com

## 4. The 14-Day Production Sprint Delivery Model

VISTAR replaces ambiguous, open-ended agency retainers with structured, milestone-guaranteed sprints:

* **Days 1–3: Architecture & Scope Alignment**
  * Define exact user flows, database schemas, and API contracts.
  * Establish GitHub repository and deployment pipeline on day one.
* **Days 4–11: Core Engineering & Testing**
  * Direct build phase: front-end UI, backend database, integrations, and automated tests.
  * Daily async video or WhatsApp progress updates.
* **Days 12–14: Deployment, QA & Repository Handover**
  * Production launch on client's infrastructure (Vercel, AWS, or GCP).
  * 100% private GitHub repository rights transfer and walkthrough documentation.
